summary: Payment on hold for BlueRidge Analytics: remittance address not confirmed preventing scheduled ACH
description:
Issue summary:
BlueRidge Analytics (vendor ID BR-904) invoice BR-2026-0310 for $18,450.00 was queued for scheduled ACH today but the payment was held by Payments due to lack of a confirmed remittance address in the vendor profile. The vendor has requested same-day payment to avoid service interruption.

Impact:
- Immediate financial exposure: vendor services (data pipeline) scheduled for renewal tomorrow may be paused.
- Operational: Procurement and AP workload increases as we need to expedite verification.
- Number of invoices affected: 1 (this invoice).

Environment:
- Internal ledger: PROD; Vendor record resides in Finance Vendor Master (VEND-DB prod-us-east).
- Payment method: ACH (domestic).
- PO referenced: PO-48231 (fixed-price monthly).

Steps to reproduce / How this presented:
1) Procurement submitted invoice BR-2026-0310 and attached to PO-48231 on 2026-03-09.
2) Automated matching passed but profile validation flagged missing remittance_address_verified flag.
3) Payment scheduler put transaction into HOLD queue pending manual verification.
4) Payments team attempted to reach vendor contact but initial email bounced.

Logs / Evidence:
- Payment scheduler log (payments-scheduler-2026-03-11.log): "HOLD: vendor_profile_missing_remittance for BR-904, invoice BR-2026-0310"
- Attached: invoice_BR-2026-0310.pdf, po_48231.pdf, vendor-email-emily-stone.eml

Background / Notes:
- Vendor onboarding for BlueRidge was completed in 2023 but remittance verification was flagged incomplete during a previous vendor validation sweep (INT-7654). Procurement believed verification had been completed; Finance automation suggests the verification flag is still false.

Investigation notes (so far):
- 2026-03-10 09:20 (Rajiv): Checked vendor master; remittance_address_verified=false and the remittance_address field is populated but not confirmed.
- 2026-03-10 11:05 (Sophie Li, Procurement): Found an email thread with vendor confirming bank details but no proof-of-account or signed remittance confirmation attached.
- 2026-03-10 12:30 (Maya): Reached out to vendor contact Emily Stone for scanned bank confirmation; bounce noted for primary address; second address provided by vendor in email attached.
- System behavior hypothesis: The Payments rule engine requires either (a) remittance_address_verified flag true OR (b) a signed remittance confirmation file attached to the vendor record. Automation does not treat inbound email attachments as verification.

Proposed resolution / Plan of action:
1) Short-term (same business day): Manually set remittance_address_verified=true for BR-904 after receiving and validating supporting documentation from vendor (procurement to confirm with vendor via phone). Finance to run a manual ACH with dual-approval (Rajiv + Head of AP) and mark this invoice as expedited.
2) Medium-term: Update Payments automation to accept vendor-email attachments that meet signature and file-type checks when linked to vendor ID (tech task: PAY-automation-139).
3) Follow-up: Add a vendor-onboarding checklist item in Confluence and schedule a runbook update (owner: Sophie Li).

Resolution ETA: Pending vendor confirmation; target manual payment by 2026-03-12 EOD if docs received.

Requested immediate actions:
- Procurement: attempt phone verification and request scanned bank confirmation (Sophie Li).
- Payments: prepare manual payment workflow and approval route (Rajiv Patel).
- Finance Ops: temporarily whitelist BR-904 for expedited ACH if documentation is received via verified phone call.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:30 - Rajiv Patel: Found HOLD entry in payments-scheduler. Vendor remittance flag is false. Will attempt contact via phone and email.

2026-03-10 10:10 - Sophie Li (Procurement): I have a ticket in our procurement tracker indicating vendor sent a PDF last quarter but I cannot locate the signed remittance in Vendor Master. Reached out to vendor; will call now.

2026-03-10 12:45 - Maya Chen (Reporter): Vendor primary email bounced. Vendor provided alternate contact (emily.stone@blueridge-ops.com) in procurement thread (attached). Sophie to confirm via phone and upload scanned confirmation.

2026-03-10 14:05 - Rajiv Patel: Prepared manual ACH checklist and approval flow. Waiting on documentation to mark remittance_verified. If we receive docs by 15:30 we can run payment today with double sign-off.

2026-03-11 08:50 - Emily Stone (Vendor) via procurement phone call (procurement note): Confirmed account details verbally and agreed to email signed confirmation. Procurement expects email before 2026-03-11 EOD.

2026-03-12 09:00 - Rajiv Patel: Received scanned confirmation and updated vendor profile; payment queued for manual approval. Forwarding to Head of AP for sign-off. Will update ticket after payment posts.
next_steps: 1) Head of AP to approve manual ACH. 2) Payments to execute manual payment and confirm ledger posting. 3) Procurement to attach signed remittance confirmation to vendor master and close onboarding gap. 4) Engineering (Payments automation) to triage PAY-automation-139 for automation acceptance of vendor-email attachments.
owner_notes: If manual payment is blocked by compliance for any reason, escalate to Finance Director (Alicia Romero) and mark ticket as Blocked. Ensure audit trail (signed PDF + phone call log) is attached before processing.
